comparison.objective: Refit a loaded drawer above riding height so rear hooks clear the rollers, close it, then pull-test it; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support, level insertion, hook-over-roller placement and pull verification versus hex-key/collar work and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer rides on both slides, closes and reopens within specified pose limits without losing its load; candidate requires two non-bottoming stops. Candidate dynamic thresholds are incomplete.
comparison.reason: The drawer task tests hidden rail engagement and loaded insertion, not adjustment of stopping dynamics.
